While making it so you need 100 ccp to be able to downvote is a nice way to combat bots, it still doesn't make it too effective for someone who post whores. My idea was that in order to vote, you must make a comment. This way, if you want to downvote someone, you will be giving a reason as to why you are downvoting. When people make a comment something like "I'm just commenting to vote." then they can be flagged for abuse/brigading and/or the account get suspended. Making a reply will allow you to apply one vote to the post and a reply to someones comment would allow you to vote on that persons comment.

Think of it like a reward for contributing to Voat.

The downside is that there will be much less votes being made because not everyone wants to comment or engage in discussion.

Good idea! But allow me to propose a modification:

The comment is the vote/the vote is public on the comment (upvotes can stay private, all downvotes must be publicly supported by a comment). And rather than 1000x repeat "This is racist, downvote" comments, you can instead choose to post a positive comment below an existing downvote comment to support it, and add to its weight.

This will cluster the opinions together, so rather than getting a mass of replies that are similar and drown out dissenting opinions, we cluster together the broad sides of the argument and there is higher visibility for minority opinions.

If we are going to have to put with more and more restrictions to upvoat and downvoat then they should just remove them all together. The CCP point restriction is enough. If people want to downvoat they will just through every hoop you put in their way.
